hero.title: MEET
hero.intro: A personal trainer who makes getting stronger feel clear, achievable and genuinely enjoyable.

story.lead: Training should give you more than tired muscles. It should give you confidence, capability and momentum.
story.paragraph1: Peter combines years of experience in sport with an attentive, down-to-earth coaching style. The aim isn’t to make fitness your whole life, it’s to make training a part of life that helps everything else feel better.
story.paragraph2: That means clear programming, honest feedback, proper technique and room for enjoyment. Whether you are touching a barbell for the first time or building towards a new personal best, the process starts with you.
story.quote: My role is to meet you where you are, and help you see how far you can go.

values.title: Personal
values.text: Your experience, schedule and goals shape the plan.

values.title: Practical
values.text: Training that works in the gym and supports life outside it.

values.title: Progressive
values.text: Clear challenges, measured progress and constant learning.

values.title: Positive
values.text: A serious approach to results in a welcoming environment.
